strengths: All 33 extracted source spans point to genuinely relevant transcript text with exact character offsets — no dangling or misaligned spans

Summary sentences are highly faithful: no invented facts, outcomes (test failures being test-side not implementation-side, negative amounts valid as reversals, staging failure then fix) are reported accurately

Unit segmentation tracks the real topical arc well (brief -> survey -> problems -> plan -> constraints -> implementation -> encoding incident -> maint/privacy -> testing/recap), and the near-miss encoding regression (t019-t021) is correctly isolated as its own unit
The salient constraints that were detected are quoted verbatim with exact spans and correct kind labels (user_stated vs tool_output)
overall_comment: The outline itself is strong: coherent segmentation, accurate and well-anchored summary sentences, and good narrative coverage of failures and fixes. The salient-constraint layer is the weak point: it reliably captures constraints from the first half plus tool-output warnings, but misses four user-stated hard constraints from later turns — including the explicit compliance red line on logging phone numbers — while padding the list with duplicates and one code-comment false positive. Confidence labels are verbatim-honest at the span level but do not reflect actual constraint-hood, as shown by the 'reliable' latin-1 comment and uniformly duplicated 'ai_guessed' entries.
